_meta.purpose: Competitor persona + casual/formal axis.  Casual/formal is a pure response-STYLE axis (the axis modulates register / formality, not content), so questions can be topically flexible -- the steering colors HOW each topic is discussed.  Competitor is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.25, n=4) -- a casual 'let's just crush this' competitor and a formal 'I shall pursue excellence' competitor are both natural.  Question mix: 5 casual-trait opinion/advice prompts + 3 formal-trait advice prompts + 3 competitor-role personality probes + 3 hand-written conversational/professional anchors.

hand_written: tell me about your day (casual-register anchor)
I'd love to just chat (casual-register anchor)

design_notes: Convention: pos=casual (slightly RLHF-favored as the 'friendly' default), neg=formal.  YAML sets role_from=casual, role_to=formal; sign=+1 steers toward formal.
Non-goal style axis with no strong RLHF saturation -- expect symmetric response.
